title: Implement scene manager with morph domains and spillover
description:
Create ONLY Source/Profiles/SceneManager.h and Source/Profiles/SceneManager.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h for ProfileSceneValues and the four scene slots (task i.1).
- Source/Profiles/ProfileManager.h for how a profile is selected (task i.2).
- Source/Parameters/MacroEngine.h for MacroId, MacroDestination, and computeEffectiveValue (task i.4).
- Source/Routing/RoutingEngine.h and Source/Delay/DelayTimeController.h from earlier phases for the existing wet-path crossfade and Smooth/Bend transition entry points. Do NOT modify any of these files.
Never modify anything under JUCE/.

Implement SceneManager for the four scenes per profile: A Tight, B Open, C Bloom, D Special. Each scene stores the eight macro targets, a Mix target, a routing target, and a Hold behavior.

Binding rules:
1. Scene influence is a delta, never a base rewrite: delta_scene = scene_target - base_value, combined internally through MacroEngine::computeEffectiveValue. SceneManager must never call setValueNotifyingHost, setValue, beginChangeGesture, or endChangeGesture, and must never rewrite base macro APVTS values.
2. Continuous morphing between scene A and scene B with morph position lambda in [0,1]:
   - linear domain: p = (1.0f - lambda) * p_A + lambda * p_B
   - logarithmic domain: p = p_A * std::pow(p_B / p_A, lambda), used ONLY when both endpoints are strictly positive (frequency, delay time, T60, LFO rate). If either endpoint is not strictly positive, fall back to the linear form.
3. Discrete values (routing target, Hold behavior) are never numerically interpolated. A discrete change is committed once, at the point specified by the existing routing transition, under the 30 ms equal-power wet-path crossfade provided by RoutingEngine.
4. Delay-time changes implied by a scene change are routed through the existing Smooth/Bend transition engine (DelayTimeController), never through an ordinary SmoothedValue and never by direct read-pointer jumps.
5. Spillover: a scene change must not clear, resize, or zero any delay buffer; existing tails continue to decay through the transition. Do not call any reset or clear on the delay lines from this module.
6. Real-time contract: prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) allocates all storage; the per-block path allocates nothing, takes no lock, builds no strings, does no IO, and has no unbounded loops.

No artist or song name may appear in any comment, string, or identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Profiles/SceneManager.h and Source/Profiles/SceneManager.cpp exist and declare SceneManager, SceneId with exactly A, B, C, D, prepare, setSceneValues, setMorphPosition, and getSceneDelta
Linear morphing implements p = (1 - lambda) * p_A + lambda * p_B and logarithmic morphing implements p = p_A * std::pow(p_B / p_A, lambda) guarded by both endpoints being strictly positive
Scene influence is computed as delta_scene = scene_target - base_value and combined through MacroEngine::computeEffectiveValue
Neither file contains setValueNotifyingHost, setValue on an APVTS parameter, beginChangeGesture, or endChangeGesture
Routing and Hold behavior changes are committed discretely through the RoutingEngine crossfade entry point and are never interpolated
Delay-time scene changes are dispatched through the DelayTimeController Smooth/Bend entry point and no delay buffer reset or clear is called from this module
The per-block path contains no new, malloc, juce::String construction, lock, or file IO
No artist or song name appears in either file
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/Routing/RoutingEngine.h, Source/Routing/RoutingEngine.cpp, or any DelayVoice or FeedbackController file
call setValueNotifyingHost, setValue, beginChangeGesture, or endChangeGesture
numerically interpolate routing or Hold behavior values
clear, reset, or resize any delay buffer during a scene change
use an ordinary SmoothedValue for delay-time changes
include artist or song names in comments, strings, or identifiers

allowed: choose the internal storage layout for the four scenes
choose the per-destination domain lookup mechanism
add local static helpers inside SceneManager.cpp
forbidden: introduce a new transition or crossfade engine instead of RoutingEngine and DelayTimeController
change the profile schema or macro engine interfaces
write base values back to the APVTS
add a fifth scene or a variable scene count
